response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM order_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_amount_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share
